questions.question: How many orders were delivered to customers?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(order_id) AS delivered_orders FROM orders WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL
questions.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) AS delivered_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered'

questions.question: What share of delivered orders arrived after the promised date?
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(is_late::INTEGER) / COUNT(order_id), 4) AS late_delivery_rate FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered'
questions.reference_sql: SELECT round(avg(is_late::INTEGER), 4) AS late_rate FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered'

questions.question: What is the average review score for late deliveries compared with on-time deliveries?
questions.sql: SELECT AVG(review_score) AS avg_review_score, is_late FROM orders WHERE review_score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY is_late
questions.reference_sql: SELECT is_late, round(avg(review_score), 2) AS avg_review FROM orders WHERE is_late IS NOT NULL GROUP BY is_late ORDER BY is_late

questions.question: Which 5 product categories sold the most in item revenue (price, without freight)?
questions.sql: SELECT category, SUM(price) AS total_revenue FROM order_items GROUP BY category ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5
questions.reference_sql: SELECT category, round(sum(price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items GROUP BY category ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: Which 5 customer states have the highest late delivery rate, among states with at least 1000 delivered orders?
questions.sql: WITH late_orders AS ( SELECT customer_state, COUNT(*) AS late_count FROM orders WHERE is_late = TRUE AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_state HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000 ) SELECT late_orders.customer_state, ROUND(SUM(late_orders.late_count) / COUNT(*)::FLOAT, 4) AS late_rate FROM orders JOIN late_orders ON orders.customer_state = late_orders.customer_state WHERE is_late = TRUE AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY late_orders.customer_state ORDER BY late_rate DESC LIMIT 5
questions.reference_sql: SELECT customer_state, round(avg(is_late::INTEGER), 4) AS late_rate FROM orders WHERE is_late IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_state HAVING count(*) >= 1000 ORDER BY late_rate DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: How did the number of orders per month change from January 2017 to August 2018?
questions.sql: SELECT purchase_month, COUNT(order_id) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE purchase_month BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2018-08-01' GROUP BY purchase_month ORDER BY purchase_month
questions.reference_sql: SELECT purchase_month, count(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE purchase_month BETWEEN DATE '2017-01-01' AND DATE '2018-08-01' GROUP BY purchase_month ORDER BY purchase_month

questions.question: What share of orders is paid mainly with each payment type (credit_card, boleto, voucher, debit_card)?
questions.sql: SELECT payment_type, ROUND(SUM(payment_value) / (SELECT SUM(payment_value) FROM orders), 4) AS payment_type_share FROM orders GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY payment_type_share DESC
questions.reference_sql: SELECT payment_type, round(count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 4) AS share FROM orders WHERE payment_type IN ('credit_card', 'boleto', 'voucher', 'debit_card') GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY share DESC

questions.question: What is the average number of days from purchase to delivery for delivered orders?
questions.sql: SELECT AVG(delivery_days) AS avg_delivery_days FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered'
questions.reference_sql: SELECT round(avg(delivery_days), 2) AS avg_delivery_days FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered'

questions.question: Which 5 customer states wait the longest on average for delivery, in days from purchase?
questions.sql: SELECT customer_state, AVG(delivery_days) AS avg_delivery_days FROM orders WHERE delivery_days IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY avg_delivery_days DESC LIMIT 5
questions.reference_sql: SELECT customer_state, round(avg(delivery_days), 2) AS avg_delivery_days FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered' GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY avg_delivery_days DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: What share of customers placed more than one order?
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN order_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id), 4) AS share_customers_more_than_one_order FROM ( SELECT customer_unique_id, COUNT(order_id) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY customer_unique_id ) AS customer_orders
questions.reference_sql: SELECT round(avg((n > 1)::INTEGER), 4) AS repeat_share FROM (SELECT customer_unique_id, count(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY customer_unique_id)

questions.question: What is the average order value (items plus freight paid) for delivered orders?
questions.sql: SELECT AVG(items_value + freight_value) AS avg_order_value FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered'
questions.reference_sql: SELECT round(avg(payment_value), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered'

questions.question: Which 5 sellers had the most item revenue, and from which state are they?
questions.sql: SELECT seller_id, seller_state, SUM(price) AS total_revenue FROM orders JOIN order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id GROUP BY seller_id, seller_state ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5
questions.reference_sql: SELECT i.seller_id, i.seller_state, round(sum(i.price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items i GROUP BY i.seller_id, i.seller_state ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: What share of orders was canceled?
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'canceled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(order_id), 4) AS cancellation_rate FROM orders WHERE purchase_month BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2018-08-01'
questions.reference_sql: SELECT round(avg((status = 'canceled')::INTEGER), 4) AS canceled_share FROM orders

questions.question: How many distinct sellers are there in each of the 3 states with the most sellers?
questions.sql: SELECT seller_state, COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) AS distinct_sellers FROM sellers GROUP BY seller_state ORDER BY distinct_sellers DESC LIMIT 3
questions.reference_sql: SELECT seller_state, count(*) AS sellers FROM sellers GROUP BY seller_state ORDER BY sellers DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: For which 5 product categories with at least 500 items sold is freight the largest share of item price, measured as total freight divided by total item price?
questions.sql: SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(freight_value) / SUM(price), 2) AS freight_share FROM order_items WHERE category != 'unknown' GROUP BY category HAVING COUNT(*) >= 500 ORDER BY freight_share DESC LIMIT 5
questions.reference_sql: SELECT category, round(sum(freight_value) / sum(price), 4) AS freight_ratio FROM order_items GROUP BY category HAVING count(*) >= 500 ORDER BY freight_ratio DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: What is the average review score of orders delivered more than 10 days after the promised date?
questions.sql: SELECT AVG(review_score) AS avg_review_score FROM orders WHERE days_late > 10 AND review_score IS NOT NULL
questions.reference_sql: SELECT round(avg(review_score), 2) AS avg_review FROM orders WHERE days_late > 10

questions.question: How many installments do credit card orders use on average?
questions.sql: SELECT AVG(installments) AS avg_installments FROM orders WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card'
questions.reference_sql: SELECT round(avg(installments), 2) AS avg_installments FROM orders WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card'

questions.question: What was the total payment value of all orders placed in 2017?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(payment_value) AS total_payment_value FROM orders WHERE purchase_month BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2017-12-01'
questions.reference_sql: SELECT round(sum(payment_value), 2) AS total_paid FROM orders WHERE year(purchased_at) = 2017

questions.question: What share of delivered orders got a 1-star review?
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN review_score = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(order_id), 4) AS share_1_star FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered'
questions.reference_sql: SELECT round(avg((review_score = 1)::INTEGER), 4) AS one_star_share FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered' AND review_score IS NOT NULL

questions.question: How did the monthly late delivery rate evolve between January 2017 and August 2018?
questions.sql: WITH monthly_late AS ( SELECT purchase_month, AVG(is_late::INTEGER) AS late_rate FROM orders WHERE purchase_month BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2018-08-01' GROUP BY purchase_month ) SELECT purchase_month, ROUND(late_rate, 4) AS late_delivery_rate FROM monthly_late ORDER BY purchase_month
questions.reference_sql: SELECT purchase_month, round(avg(is_late::INTEGER), 4) AS late_rate FROM orders WHERE is_late IS NOT NULL AND purchase_month BETWEEN DATE '2017-01-01' AND DATE '2018-08-01' GROUP BY purchase_month ORDER BY purchase_month

questions.question: What share of item revenue comes from sellers in São Paulo state (SP)?
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN seller_state = 'SP' THEN items_value ELSE 0 END) / SUM(items_value), 4) AS sp_revenue_share FROM orders JOIN order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id
questions.reference_sql: SELECT round(sum(price) FILTER (WHERE seller_state = 'SP') / sum(price), 4) AS sp_share FROM order_items

questions.question: Which 3 product categories have the lowest average review score, among categories with at least 1000 reviewed orders? Use the category of each order's first item and leave out the 'unknown' category.
questions.sql: SELECT category, AVG(review_score) AS avg_review_score FROM orders JOIN order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id WHERE category != 'unknown' GROUP BY category HAVING COUNT(order_items.order_id) >= 1000 ORDER BY avg_review_score ASC LIMIT 3
questions.reference_sql: SELECT i.category, round(avg(o.review_score), 2) AS avg_review FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id AND i.item_seq = 1 WHERE o.review_score IS NOT NULL AND i.category <> 'unknown' GROUP BY i.category HAVING count(*) >= 1000 ORDER BY avg_review LIMIT 3

questions.question: What is the average number of items per order, for orders with at least one item?
questions.sql: SELECT AVG(items) AS avg_items_per_order FROM orders WHERE items > 0
questions.reference_sql: SELECT round(avg(items), 2) AS avg_items FROM orders WHERE items > 0

questions.question: In which month between January 2017 and August 2018 were the most orders placed, and how many?
questions.sql: SELECT purchase_month, COUNT(order_id) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE purchase_month BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2018-08-01' GROUP BY purchase_month ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1
questions.reference_sql: SELECT purchase_month, count(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE purchase_month BETWEEN DATE '2017-01-01' AND DATE '2018-08-01' GROUP BY purchase_month ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What share of orders shipped to customers in the seller's own state? Count orders whose first item's seller is in the customer's state.
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.customer_state = oi.seller_state THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS prop_same_state FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE oi.item_seq = 1
questions.reference_sql: SELECT round(avg((i.seller_state = o.customer_state)::INTEGER), 4) AS same_state_share FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id AND i.item_seq = 1
